details:
I am trying to upload an avatar that supports quest with SDK base and SDK avator version 3.1.8.
When I press Build & Publish for Android in build target to Android, I get the following error and the build does not start.
FileNotFoundException: %USERPROFILE%/AppData/Local/Temp/DefaultCompany/<UnityProjectName>/prefab-id-v1_avtr_<Blueprintid>_<random_number>.prefab.unity3d does not exist
System.IO.File.Copy (System.String sourceFileName, System.String destFileName, System.Boolean overwrite) (at <eae584ce26bc40229c1b1aa476bfa589>:0)
VRC.SDK3.Builder.VRCAvatarBuilder.ExportCurrentAvatarResource (UnityEngine.Object avatarResource, System.Boolean testAsset) (at <e4d4b2ccc3324a4182d3751a7a132541>:0)
VRC.SDK3.Builder.VRCAvatarBuilder.ExportAndUploadAvatarBlueprint (UnityEngine.GameObject externalReference) (at <e4d4b2ccc3324a4182d3751a7a132541>:0)
VRC.SDKBase.Editor.VRC_SdkBuilder.ExportAndUploadAvatarBlueprint (UnityEngine.GameObject externalReference) (at <d180eee816ea4a1a9db5608bed36624b>:0)
VRC.SDK3.Editor.VRCSdkControlPanelAvatarBuilder3A.OnGUIAvatar (VRC.SDKBase.VRC_AvatarDescriptor avatar) (at Packages/com.vrchat.avatars/Editor/VRCSDK/SDK3A/VRCSdkControlPanelAvatarBuilder3A.cs:582)
VRC.SDKBase.Editor.VRCSdkControlPanelAvatarBuilder.ShowBuilder () (at Packages/com.vrchat.base/Editor/VRCSDK/Dependencies/VRChat/ControlPanel/VRCSdkControlPanelAvatarBuilder.cs:159)
VRCSdkControlPanel.ShowBuilders () (at Packages/com.vrchat.base/Editor/VRCSDK/Dependencies/VRChat/ControlPanel/VRCSdkControlPanelBuilder.cs:329)
VRCSdkControlPanel.OnGUI () (at Packages/com.vrchat.base/Editor/VRCSDK/Dependencies/VRChat/ControlPanel/VRCSdkControlPanel.cs:214)
System.Reflection.MonoMethod.Invoke (System.Object obj, System.Reflection.BindingFlags invokeAttr, System.Reflection.Binder binder, System.Object[] parameters, System.Globalization.CultureInfo culture) (at <eae584ce26bc40229c1b1aa476bfa589>:0)
Rethrow as TargetInvocationException: Exception has been thrown by the target of an invocation.
System.Reflection.MonoMethod.Invoke (System.Object obj, System.Reflection.BindingFlags invokeAttr, System.Reflection.Binder binder, System.Object[] parameters, System.Globalization.CultureInfo culture) (at <eae584ce26bc40229c1b1aa476bfa589>:0)
System.Reflection.MethodBase.Invoke (System.Object obj, System.Object[] parameters) (at <eae584ce26bc40229c1b1aa476bfa589>:0)
UnityEditor.HostView.Invoke (System.String methodName, System.Object obj) (at <a259d3c004024353a2c217da97495055>:0)
UnityEditor.HostView.Invoke (System.String methodName) (at <a259d3c004024353a2c217da97495055>:0)
The error message indicates that the SDK is trying to read a invalid prefab file path.
The path should be: %USERPROFILE%/AppData/Local/Temp/DefaultCompany/<UnityProjectName>/Assets/prefab-id-v1_avtr_<Blueprintid>_<random_number >.prefab.unity3d
and this is occurring because the "Assets" path is missing.
Downgrading the SDK base and SDK avator versions to 3.1.7 resolves the above error and the upload is successful.
We believe this is an error with version 3.1.8 and would appreciate your response.
The text has been translated by deepl. The original Japanese text is given below.
SDK base、 SDK avatorのバージョンを3.1.8の状態で、quest対応のアバターをアップロードするため、
build target to AndroidでBuild & Publish for Androidを押すと下記のエラーが出てBuildがスタートしません。
FileNotFoundException: %USERPROFILE%/AppData/Local/Temp/DefaultCompany/<UnityProjectName>/Assets/prefab-id-v1_avtr_<Blueprintid>_<random_number>.prefab.unity3d does not exist

System.Reflection.MonoMethod.Invoke (System.Object obj, System.Reflection.BindingFlags invokeAttr, System.Reflection.Binder binder, System.Object[] parameters, System.Globalization.CultureInfo culture) (at <eae584ce26bc40229c1b1aa476bfa589>:0)
Rethrow as TargetInvocationException: Exception has been thrown by the target of an invocation.
System.Reflection.MonoMethod.Invoke (System.Object obj, System.Reflection.BindingFlags invokeAttr, System.Reflection.Binder binder, System.Object[] parameters, System.Globalization.CultureInfo culture) (at <eae584ce26bc40229c1b1aa476bfa589>:0)

UnityEditor.HostView.Invoke (System.String methodName) (at <a259d3c004024353a2c217da97495055>:0)
エラーを確認すると、プロジェクトディレクトリ以下のprefabファイルを読もうとしているが、存在しないためエラーとなっています。
本来読まれるパスは%USERPROFILE%/AppData/Local/Temp/DefaultCompany/<UnityProjectName>/Assets/prefab-id-v1_avtr_<Blueprintid>_<random_number>.prefab.unity3d
であり、「Assets」のパスが抜けているため発生しています。
SDK base、 SDK avatorのバージョンを3.1.7にダウングレードすると上記エラーは解消し、アップロードが成功します。
バージョン3.1.8のエラーと思いますので対応をお願いします。
title: Cannot upload Quest-enabled avatars with SDK version 3.1.8
